description:
README.md lines 548-563 lists the ClientError variants but omits RateLimited { retry_after: UTCDate } which is defined in error.rs:367-371.

The variant is part of the public contract (the rustdoc on error.rs:346-365 explicitly notes 'The variant is part of the public contract so [...] callers that want to handle rate limiting via this typed variant have a stable target to match on'). A caller wanting to handle 429 via exhaustive match against a #[non_exhaustive] enum needs to know the variant exists.

The variant rustdoc also notes that today the base crate does not produce this variant (HTTP 429 surfaces as ClientError::Http), which is itself useful context for the README to mention as a 'currently-unused-public-variant' note rather than silently omitting.

Fix: add the RateLimited row to the README error table, and mention the 'currently surfaces via ClientError::Http' caveat from error.rs:346-365.
title: README error variants table missing RateLimited
